items.summary: Allow the app to be configured with a single ActivePieces webhook URL for both file upload processing and Ask AI by supporting the case where VITE_ENDPOINT_A_URL and VITE_ENDPOINT_B_URL point to the same URL and by providing a fallback so that if only one of these environment variables is set, the app uses the configured one for both actions.

When calling the single ActivePieces webhook URL, include an explicit action discriminator in the POST request body so the external automation can route the request appropriately: file uploads must send action="process_notes" and expect {summary, quiz_array}; Ask AI must send action="ask_ai" along with user_question and uploaded_notes and expect {ai_answer}.

Update the frontend configuration documentation/template to reflect that a single webhook URL can be used for both actions, while still supporting separate URLs, and ensure all guidance is in English.
